cell: Size of one dither cell. Larger cells give a chunkier, more pixelated look and are cheaper to draw.
matrix: The threshold pattern that decides which cells are inked: bayer2, bayer4, bayer8 or blue-noise. See Matrices.
animated: Turn the motion on or off. Follows DitherTheme.animated by default, so one switch stills the whole app.
speed: Multiplies the speed of the animation. 2 plays twice as fast.
still-time: The moment, in seconds, that is drawn while animated is false.
palette: The colours, from the background to the ink. Cells take the nearest colour in the list. Two or more colours.
bloom: A soft glow in the ink colour around the dither: off, low or high.
enabled: Whether the component takes input. A disabled one is dimmed.
fill: The texture: gradient steps through dither levels, dotted and hatched are fixed patterns and solid is flat.
interactive: Hover and click behaviour. Turn it off for a decorative component.
unit: Written after every value, such as % or GB.
hover-effect: What it does when the pointer comes in: sweep, spotlight, scan, trace, rise, noise or none. Follows DitherMotion.hover by default. See Motion.
press-effect: What it does when it is pressed: ripple, burst, flash, pulse, glitch or none. Follows DitherMotion.press by default.
idle-effect: What it does on its own while on screen: none, shimmer, breathe or twinkle. Follows DitherMotion.idle by default.
effect-matrix: The dither pattern of the motion effects. Follows DitherMotion.matrix by default.
has-hover: Whether the pointer is over it. Read only.
pressed: Whether it is being pressed. Read only.
has-focus: Whether it has keyboard focus. Read only.
clicked: Called when it is clicked, or activated with the keyboard.
